prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1331; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end collision involving a vehicle insured under your policy. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already spoken with our client, please let us know so that we can address it.

We request that you provide a complete certified copy of the policy in force on the date of the accident, including a declarations page showing all liability coverage limits, along with confirmation of any additional coverage that may apply. Please also identify the claims handler assigned to this file.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera and telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, the insured vehicle itself if it remains in your possession, adjuster notes, recorded statements, repair estimates, and all internal and external correspondence. Please suspend any routine deletion or destruction of these materials until this matter is fully resolved.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
